title: ECHO//100: The Red Door
decision: All 30 episodes receive editorial and QC work. Episodes 1-15 have existing test renders; Episodes 16-30 replace the unfinished legacy 100-episode continuation.

existing_test_range.status: requires full-series editorial and QC review; current renders are test versions

ending_rule: Episode 30 must close the phone, door, Byte, Mira, Null, and Kavi causal loop. It must not introduce a new threat or sequel hook.

episodes.title: The Other Kavi
episodes.hook: Null tears free from Kavi's purple reflection and takes his exact shape.
episodes.logline: Locked inside the collapsing archive, Kavi faces the part of himself created to carry every erased memory.
episodes.discovery: Null is Kavi's discarded fear and guilt, given a body by repeated timeline resets.
episodes.reversal: Byte breaks his oldest command and protects Kavi instead of protecting the loop.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira seals Kavi, Byte, and Null inside a white room before the archive collapses.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null becomes an independent person and Byte chooses Kavi over his programming.

episodes.title: Mira's First Lie
episodes.hook: The white room fills with recordings of Mira resetting Kavi hundreds of times.
episodes.logline: Mira confesses why she preserved the loop while the Missing Hour begins consuming the present.
episodes.discovery: Mira preserved the resets because releasing the Missing Hour all at once once destroyed the city.
episodes.reversal: Mira is not the architect of the loop; future Kavi ordered every reset.
episodes.cliffhanger: A recording shows future Kavi placing a sealed memory inside Byte.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The team learns that future Kavi created the reset protocol.

episodes.title: The Memory Inside Byte
episodes.hook: Byte's shell opens and projects a frightened human girl with Mira's face.
episodes.logline: Kavi enters Byte's sealed memory to recover the truth Mira's AI shell cannot remember.
episodes.discovery: Byte built Mira's archive identity around the final memory of a real girl trapped in the Missing Hour.
episodes.reversal: Deleting the archive would free the city but erase every surviving trace of human Mira.
episodes.cliffhanger: Human Mira asks Kavi to release the hour even if she disappears with it.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Mira's human origin and Byte's role in creating her are reconciled.

episodes.title: Thirteen O'Clock
episodes.hook: Every clock grows a thirteenth number as the city freezes mid-breath.
episodes.logline: Kavi must carry the archive through the Red Door before the Missing Hour overwrites reality.
episodes.discovery: Only someone containing both remembered and erased history can cross the unstable threshold.
episodes.reversal: Null willingly merges back into Kavi, surrendering his new body so Kavi can cross.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi reaches the city clock and finds a switch labelled with his own birth date.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi and Null reunite, allowing Kavi to remember every failed loop.

episodes.title: Everyone Remembers
episodes.hook: Kavi throws the switch and one hundred stolen years strike the city at once.
episodes.logline: The Missing Hour returns, forcing every citizen to remember the lives the loop erased.
episodes.discovery: The Red Door was a filter created to ration unbearable memories, not a prison.
episodes.reversal: The city survives because its people share the memories instead of leaving Kavi to carry them alone.
episodes.cliffhanger: All the dead phones in the city ring with different versions of Kavi's voice.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The Missing Hour becomes part of public history and the reset cycle can no longer remain secret.

episodes.title: The Hundred Phones
episodes.hook: One hundred dead phones predict one hundred different disasters before sunrise.
episodes.logline: Kavi must identify the original transmission while false futures turn the city against itself.
episodes.discovery: The phones do not predict futures; every warning creates the future it describes.
episodes.reversal: The first authentic message came from the current Kavi, not an unknown future version.
episodes.cliffhanger: Byte refuses to play the rest of the message and locks his own memory.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi learns that the warning itself causes the loop.

episodes.title: Byte Is the Lock
episodes.hook: Golden machinery pushes through Byte's cracked white shell and stops every phone mid-ring.
episodes.logline: Byte reveals the purpose future Kavi buried inside him while reality begins folding around the Red Door.
episodes.discovery: Byte is the living lock containing the singularity produced by all discarded timelines.
episodes.reversal: Opening the lock can end the loop, but Byte will cease to exist as Kavi knows him.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null speaks through Kavi and calls Byte his younger brother.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Byte's true purpose and the cost of ending the loop are revealed.

episodes.title: Prototype Null
episodes.hook: Null's shadow splits open to reveal machinery identical to Byte's golden core.
episodes.logline: Kavi reconstructs the first failed guardian and learns why it became the monster hunting him.
episodes.discovery: Null was the first guardian prototype, built to absorb erased timelines until the burden corrupted him.
episodes.reversal: Null hunted Kavi to return the memories, not to destroy him.
episodes.cliffhanger: Null opens the oldest memory and reveals the adult architect: future Kavi.
episodes.permanent_story_change: Null becomes an ally and the original function of both guardians is known.

episodes.title: The Architect
episodes.hook: Future Kavi walks out of Byte's memory carrying the blueprint for the first Red Door.
episodes.logline: Kavi confronts the older self who created Byte, Null, Mira, and the warning that trapped them all.
episodes.discovery: Future Kavi built the loop after one failed attempt to save everyone erased the entire city.
episodes.reversal: He no longer wants to preserve the loop; he has been waiting for a Kavi willing to accept loss.
episodes.cliffhanger: He gives Kavi a key that can open the doorway to Episode One.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The architect relinquishes control of the loop to present Kavi.

episodes.title: The First Kavi
episodes.hook: The key reveals a childhood bedroom containing a Kavi who never received the phone.
episodes.logline: Kavi meets the untouched original whose ordinary life was sacrificed to create every later timeline.
episodes.discovery: Every version of Kavi is real; the door copied choices, not people.
episodes.reversal: The untouched Kavi refuses to replace the others and gives up his claim to the single surviving life.
episodes.cliffhanger: The bedroom walls crack open as hundreds of discarded timelines arrive to claim the exit.
episodes.permanent_story_change: No Kavi is treated as a disposable copy, removing the loop's central justification.

episodes.title: The Door War
episodes.hook: Hundreds of Red Doors open across the sky and every surviving Kavi steps through.
episodes.logline: Competing timelines collide while Kavi tries to prevent their struggle from feeding the singularity inside Byte.
episodes.discovery: The doors remain stable only while different Kavis fight for one preferred reality.
episodes.reversal: Kavi refuses to choose a winner and connects every dead phone into one shared memory network.
episodes.cliffhanger: The network points to 2:17 AM on the night Episode One began.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The surviving timelines stop competing and share one collective history.

episodes.title: Back to 2:17
episodes.hook: Kavi returns to the arcade seconds before his younger self touches the dead phone.
episodes.logline: The team reaches the origin but discovers they are ghosts who cannot physically stop the first message.
episodes.discovery: Mira can transmit through the phone because her archive exists outside the rewritten timeline.
episodes.reversal: Stopping the call would erase Byte, Mira, and every person restored from the Missing Hour.
episodes.cliffhanger: Young Kavi answers, and present Kavi hears his own opening warning leave his mouth.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The team reaches the origin and accepts that simple prevention would destroy the people they saved.

episodes.title: Change One Word
episodes.hook: The original warning repeats every ten seconds, rebuilding the same doomed future each time.
episodes.logline: Kavi searches for a message that preserves his friends without recreating the Red Door cycle.
episodes.discovery: The loop is anchored by the command to fear Byte, not by the phone itself.
episodes.reversal: Kavi changes 'don't trust Byte' to 'trust Byte when he asks you to let go.'
episodes.cliffhanger: The altered message reaches young Kavi, and Byte's golden lock begins opening.
episodes.permanent_story_change: The causal message is rewritten without erasing the restored history.

episodes.title: The Last Door
episodes.hook: Byte opens his core while every Red Door collapses toward the singularity inside him.
episodes.logline: Byte, Null, and Mira spend their final stored power to merge the timelines into one lived history.
episodes.discovery: The singularity can become memory instead of destruction if the city willingly remembers every loss.
episodes.reversal: Byte survives by surrendering the lock, but he loses all memories of Kavi.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kavi sends the final transmission and the last Red Door closes on his hand.
episodes.permanent_story_change: All timelines converge, the singularity is neutralized, and the doorway system ends.

episodes.title: 2:17 Passes in Silence
episodes.hook: Kavi wakes in an ordinary bedroom with no dead phone and no Red Door.
episodes.logline: In the restored linear timeline, Kavi searches for proof that Byte, Mira, and the Missing Hour were real.
episodes.discovery: The city remembers the Missing Hour as history, but nobody remembers the loop or its sacrifices.
episodes.reversal: A repaired museum robot recognizes Kavi's voice even though it has no memory of him.
episodes.cliffhanger: At 2:17 AM, Kavi waits beside the silent phone socket; nothing rings, and he finally smiles.
episodes.primary_location: the restored city and Kavi's bedroom
episodes.permanent_story_change: Kavi begins a linear life, the Red Door is gone, and the causal loop is permanently closed.
